tip: Reply to every comment and DM within an hour with the free-assessment link, then log the family in Leads below.
why: Speed of reply is the biggest driver of whether a curious parent books. Logging it lets the dashboard count progress toward 100.

tip: Record three 30–45 second whiteboard clips: one idea each, opening with a question (for example 'Who invented zero?').
why: Your whiteboard clips are your most distinctive content. A steady supply of 3 a week keeps the feed alive through Christmas.

tip: Announce a free Saturday family webinar for early December and a 'gift of math' prepaid year (one month free).
why: Families have time off and are planning January. A dated event gives people a reason to sign up now.
